result.summary: The main issue is the broken layout of the restaurant cards, specifically the truncated names and the overlap/clipping of elements in the scrollable sections.

issues.description: Restaurant names in the 'Fastest near you' section, specifically 'Trattoria Piccol', are truncated due to insufficient container width or incorrect text wrapping.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the padding or font size, or implement text wrapping/marquee for long restaurant names to ensure the full name is visible.

issues.description: The carousel elements in 'Fastest near you' appear to be cut off abruptly at the right edge of the screen, creating an unfinished visual aesthetic.
issues.suggestion: Improve the layout margins to allow for a partial glimpse of the next item, or ensure full card widths align properly with the screen bounds.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar and the content immediately above it (the pizza card) are visually crowded with little padding, making the UI feel cramped.
issues.suggestion: Increase the bottom margin or padding for the bottom-most list items to prevent content from appearing too close to the navigation bar.
